extracted.intended_audience: Principal Investigators, senior/key personnel, and research administrators preparing NIH PHS-398 (Research & Related) grant applications (including international institutions)
extracted.subtask_description: Preparation and completion of NIH PHS-398 research application components (biosketches, research plan, and Research & Related budget sections) and institutional grant-administration documentation for an NIH PAR-18-335 style proposal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biographical Sketch: format and page limit
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the following information for the Senior/key personnel and other significant contributors. Follow this format for each person. DO NOT EXCEED FIVE PAGES.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include required sections (Personal Statement; Positions and Honors; Contribution to Science; Other information such as Research Support/Scholastic Performance). Provide institutional/education rows (institution, degree, completion date, field). Use the specified format for each person and keep within the five-page limit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biographical Sketch: Personal Statement
rubrics_metrics.description: A concise Personal Statement describing the candidate's background, relevant experience, and role on the project (labelled 'A. Personal Statement').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain relevant prior work and how the investigator's expertise supports the proposed research and capacity-building activities; describe mentoring/training contributions if applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biographical Sketch: Positions and Honors
rubrics_metrics.description: A chronological listing of Positions and Employment and Other Experience and Professional Memberships (labelled 'B. Positions and Honors').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List employment dates and roles, committee memberships, editorial boards, fellowships, and honors that demonstrate qualifications for the proposed role.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biographical Sketch: Contribution to Science
rubrics_metrics.description: A summary of major scientific contributions (labelled 'C. Contribution to Science').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe key research accomplishments and provide representative publications (with citations). Explain the significance of contributions and how they relate to the proposed project.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement: Vertebrate Animals section
rubrics_metrics.description: Are vertebrate animals euthanized? If 'Yes', is the method consistent with American Veterinary Medical Association (AVMA) guidelines? If 'No' to AVMA guidelines, describe method and provide scientific justification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Answer the euthanasia question and, where applicable, document consistency with AVMA guidelines or provide a description/justification when deviations are necessary.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement: Program Income section
rubrics_metrics.description: Is program income anticipated during the periods for which the grant support is requested? If 'Yes', reflect the amount and source(s) by Budget Period.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If program income is anticipated, report anticipated amount ($), sources, and associated budget period(s); otherwise leave blank.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement: Human Embryonic Stem Cells (hESC) section
rubrics_metrics.description: Does the proposed project involve human embryonic stem cells? If yes, list registration number(s) of specific cell line(s) from the NIH registry or indicate that a registry line will be used.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide NIH stem cell registry identifiers (example: 0004) or check the box that a registry line will be used if a specific line cannot yet be referenced.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement: Inventions and Patents (renewals)
rubrics_metrics.description: For renewal applications, disclose whether there are inventions and patents associated with the project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Answer Yes/No to 'Inventions and Patents' and, if Yes, indicate whether previously reported.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement: Change of Investigator/Institution
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide information to indicate Change of Project Director/Principal Investigator or Change of Grantee Institution where applicable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supply names and former institution information as required when there is a change in PD/PI or grantee institution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Plan: required sections (PHS 398 Research Plan)
rubrics_metrics.description: Research Plan Section must include: Introduction (for Resubmission/Revision), Specific Aims, Research Strategy, Progress Report Publication List, and other applicable sections such as Vertebrate Animals, Select Agent Research, Multiple PD/PI Leadership Plan, Consortium/Contractual Arrangements, Letters of Support, Resource Sharing Plan(s), Authentication of Key Biological and/or Chemical Resources, and Appendix.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include each listed subsection as appropriate to the application type; upload referenced documents (e.g., SpecificAims_NOA_*.pdf; ResearchStrategy_*.pdf). Ensure resubmissions include an Introduction. Provide required items for select-agent or vertebrate animal research as applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Budget: section structure and required fields (Sections A-K)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Research & Related Budget must be completed across Sections A-K: A (Senior/Key Person), B (Other Personnel), C (Equipment), D (Travel), E (Participant/Trainee Support Costs), F (Other Direct Costs), G (Direct Costs), H (Indirect Costs), I (Total Direct and Indirect Costs), J (Fee), and K (Total Costs and Fee).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Populate required fields such as start/end dates, budget period, names, project roles, calendar/academic/summer months, salary ($), fringe benefits, funds requested ($), and totals. For Indirect Costs include Indirect Cost Rate (%), Indirect Cost Base ($), and Funds Requested ($). Complete cumulative and total fields (Sections G–K).

rubrics_metrics.name: Equipment cost reporting threshold
rubrics_metrics.description: List items and dollar amount for each item exceeding $5,000 in the Equipment section (Section C).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide an itemized list of equipment > $5,000 with dollar amounts; items below $5,000 should not be listed in this equipment section.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Justification file and content
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a Budget Justification attachment (only attach one file) describing personnel effort, equipment, supplies, travel, other expenses, and indirect costs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain percent effort and salary support requested for named personnel (e.g., PI 30% effort; Co-PI 10% effort; Project Coordinator 40% effort), list planned equipment or mark N/A, describe supplies (e.g., two laptops), itemize domestic and foreign travel (follow NIH guidelines), detail other expenses (consultancy, training, communication, publications, webinar/video conferencing, sustainability initiatives), and state indirect cost rate and basis. Attach a single file named appropriately (e.g., BUDGETJUSTIFICATIONS_*.pdf).

rubrics_metrics.name: Travel costs: NIH guidelines and allowable destinations
rubrics_metrics.description: Travel lines must separate Domestic Travel (including Canada, Mexico, and U.S. possessions) and Foreign Travel costs and must follow NIH guidelines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Budget domestic and foreign travel separately; costs should include transportation, accommodation, in-country transport, and per diem/food/incidentals as appropriate and adhere to NIH travel policies and allowable carriers where specified.

rubrics_metrics.name: Participant/Trainee Support Costs: required subcategories
rubrics_metrics.description: Participant/Trainee Support Costs (Section E) must list Tuition/Fees/Health Insurance, Stipends, Travel, Subsistence, Other, and Number of Participants/Trainees.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Populate subcategory amounts and participant counts where participant support is an element of the project; otherwise leave blank or zero as appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other Direct Costs categories (Section F)
rubrics_metrics.description: Other Direct Costs should be itemized across categories: Materials and Supplies; Publication Costs; Consultant Services; ADP/Computer Services; Subawards/Consortium/Contractual Costs; Equipment or Facility Rental/User Fees; Alterations and Renovations; and other specified line-items (e.g., sustainability, webinar, training and communication).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide line-item dollar amounts and include any additional category descriptions/files as needed; total Other Direct Costs must roll into Direct Costs (Section G).

rubrics_metrics.name: Indirect Costs specification and reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Indirect Cost Type, Indirect Cost Rate (%), Indirect Cost Base ($), and Funds Requested ($) must be provided in Section H; total indirect costs must be calculated and reported.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State the cognizant federal agency and contact, apply the institution's approved F&A rate (note: the example notes an 8% F&A for an international institution applied toward TMDC), and compute totals correctly for budget tables.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget cumulative totals and tabulation
rubrics_metrics.description: Cumulative budget tables must present totals for Sections A–K including total salary, wages and fringe benefits, equipment, travel (domestic/foreign), participant support, other direct costs, direct costs (A–F), indirect costs (H), total direct and indirect costs (I), fee (J), and total costs and fee (K).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure consistency between section subtotals and cumulative totals; include zeros or N/A where appropriate and provide tracking numbers and funding opportunity number for administrative processing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Grants Administration plan content
rubrics_metrics.description: Grant Administration/Financial Management Plan should describe the institutional Office for Research Support (ORS) structure, reporting lines, sub-units (Finance, Compliance, Documentation, IT/Database Management, Publications), and functions including pre- and post-award administrative services.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain how ORS ensures investigator compliance with administrative, financial, audit and procurement procedures; describe tracking of expenditures and balances (e.g., with Integrated Technology System), notification of reporting deadlines, audit preparedness (e.g., NIH Yellow Book Audit overview), staff training, and the ORS role in increasing grant submissions and managing externally-funded projects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Plan Appendix allowance
rubrics_metrics.description: An Appendix is a recognized part of the Research Plan (listed as '12. Appendix').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include appropriate supplementary materials allowable under NIH Appendix policy; label and attach appendix files as required.
